A page for testing what a webling eats

Lines of text for the pet to stand on. Octopuses have three hearts. A group of flamingos is a flamboyance.

Honey found in ancient tombs is still edible. Bananas are berries; strawberries are not.

Wombats make cube-shaped droppings. Sea otters hold hands while they sleep.
